description: Before spending credits, call quote_generation and explain the returned price or unknown total. For a known quote, obtain approval and pass max_credits. For an unknown total, obtain explicit acceptance and pass accept_unknown_cost:true without max_credits. Never switch consent modes or remove or raise a ceiling without new user approval. Agents charge per stage; no whole-run spending cap is enforced. Use this when the user wants a standalone video clip from text, images, or reference frames. Supports text-to-video, image-to-video, first/last-frame transition, or reference-to-video when the model supports it. Upload images with upload_image first. Flow: list_models(type=video) -> get_model_help -> generate_video -> get_task_status with the returned batch_id. For song-driven music, dance, or lyric videos, use generate_music_video, generate_dance_video, or generate_lyric_video.

accept_unknown_cost.description: Set true only after the user explicitly accepts an unknown total, without max_credits. Agents charge per stage; this does not enforce a total budget.

generate_audio.description: Generate audio with the video when the model supports it.

generation_type.description: text needs no images; image needs one; transition needs first and last frames; reference takes reference images.

images.description: Image URLs from upload_image for image, transition, or reference generation.

max_credits.description: User-approved ceiling for a known current quote. Cannot cap an unknown total or a multi-stage agent run. Never remove or raise it without new user consent.

multi_clip.description: Generate multiple clips when the model supports it.

style.description: Video style when the model supports it.

name: generate_video

batch_id.description: Open RPC batch ID for get_task_status.

success.description: Whether the batch request was accepted by Freebeat.
